A, B, C, D, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. L sits to the immediate right of D. Only three people sit between L and C when counted from the left of L. Only three people sit between D and J. A sits to the immediate right of K.

How many people sit between D and K when counted from the right of K?
questions.solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the center of the table.

1) L sits to the immediate right of D.

2) Only three people sit between L and C when counted from the left of L.

3) Only three people sit between D and J.

4) A sits to the immediate right of K.

So, B will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c1652ee9e35d2d3b41a5e47ba828eb87ab06e084956a08ecf1c68acfaca8ffd.png] 

There is one people sitting between D and K if counted from the right.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘x’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

(117 A 3) C (119 A 7) C 24 D 6 C (117 A 13) B 2 = ?

What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

25 ÷ 6 − 8 + 20 × 4 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 25 ÷ 6 − 8 + 20 × 4 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 25 × 6 + 8 - 20 ÷ 4 = ?

⇒ 25 × 6 + 8 - 5 = ?

⇒ 150 + 8 - 5 = ?

⇒ 150 + 3 = **153**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All meters are compasses.

All compasses are scales.

Conclusions:

(I) Some scales are compasses.

(II) All meters are scales.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All meters are compasses.

All compasses are scales.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc75571bf1700a5d8d57879fe32f9cbd918cb94f1aa34021b5aa94880026cea0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some scales are compasses.

- Since "All compasses are scales" (Statement 2), it means the entire group of Compasses is part of the Scales group. Therefore, it is definitively true that at least "Some scales are compasses."

Conclusion (I) logically follows.

II. All meters are scales.
- Since "All meters are compasses" (Statement 1) and "All compasses are scales" (Statement 2), by the transitive property of inclusion, all meters must necessarily be scales.
Conclusion (II) logically follows.

So, Both Conclusion (I) and Conclusion (II) logically follow from the given statements.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0431e5392b7caeda7091306a402c409c1c1c5ede029876cc4adca8f535e06062.png]
